issues: Document uses SanPiN/GOST/MUK/Order norm-references, not TR TS section headings, so tr_section is null for every row (no TR TS/раздел headings present in this document). Several ranges are printed with two unit representations (e.g. '420 мВ/м - 100,0 кВ/м [(0,42 - 100000) В/м]'); structured range_from/range_to/unit fields use the bracketed SI-normalized value (single consistent unit), while the original dual-unit text is kept verbatim in raw_row_text. Bold category/sub-category headings within the indicator column (e.g. 'Микроклимат', 'Электромагнитные поля диапазона частот...') are folded into the indicator field with an em-dash separator rather than treated as tr_section, per the rule that tr_section is reserved for TR TS/раздел section headings. All 4 pages legible, no rotation needed, no illegible spots.
